annotations.title: Propose who does a workflow's steps and what in

description: Propose claims about who does what in a WORKFLOW, and what each step is done in, from what someone said. Each claim names a step (nodeId from compass_workflow_steps), a page (subjectPageId: a ROLE or PERSON, or an AUDIENCE when a customer or partner does the step; for uses a SYSTEM or DOCUMENT; for impacts a PRIORITY; for holds_to a VALUE), and a relation: owns (accountable for it), does (does the work), approves (signs off), consulted (asked for input), does_not_do (says they don't do it — an answer, not a gap), uses (the step is done in this SYSTEM, or with this DOCUMENT; a step a system runs on its own gets uses and no doer), impacts (the step moves this PRIORITY: where the priority is won or lost; pass limits: true on the one step holding it back most), holds_to (the business lives this VALUE at the step). Propose who and what in together, in one call per workflow. Claims land as proposals for a person to accept in Compass; they don't count until then, except in a conversation about the map's questions, where what the person tells you (sourceKind 'user') is kept straight away. Always say who said it: sourceKind 'interview' + the interview id, 'email_thread' + the thread id, 'prism_report' + the desk-research report id, or 'page' + the DOCUMENT or PERSON page id. Prefer the ROLE when the person speaks for their role, the PERSON when it's specific to them. Record a disagreement as its own claim rather than skipping it. When someone says a step happens that isn't in the diagram, add the step with napkin_diagrams_update first. Re-proposing an existing claim from the same source returns it.

limits.description: For impacts: this step holds the priority back most right now.

nodeId.description: The step's node id; null = the workflow as a whole.

note.description: Their words, briefly, when they qualify it.

subjectPageId.description: The ROLE, PERSON or AUDIENCE page id; for uses, the SYSTEM or DOCUMENT page id; for impacts, the PRIORITY page id; for holds_to, the VALUE page id.

validFrom.description: When this started, if they said.

validTo.description: When this stopped, if it has.

variantId.description: Only for this variant (an id from compass_workflow_steps), e.g. who does it on rush jobs.

sourceId.description: The interview, email thread, Prism report or page id, for those kinds.

sourceKind.description: Who says so: 'interview', 'email_thread', 'prism_report', 'page', or 'user' (the person you're talking with).

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
